1	# Creating a command
2	
3	Commands are declared with `defineCommand`, `defineOption` and `defineArgument`, on top of `cliparse`. Options and arguments are validated and parsed by [Zod](https://zod.dev) schemas, and their types flow into the handler. The reasons behind this design are explained in [ADR 0001](../adr/adr-0001-rework-file-structure.md).
4	
5	Before writing a command, look at a similar one and copy its naming, file layout, output format and error messages. `src/commands/drain/` is a good example of a command group with shared arguments and options.
6	
7	## Example
8	
9	A fictional `clever coffee brew <blend>` subcommand, part of a `coffee` group (neither exists in the CLI). The `<blend>` argument is shared by several `coffee` subcommands, so it lives in `coffee.args.js`:
10	
11	```js
12	// src/commands/coffee/coffee.args.js
13	import { z } from 'zod';
14	import { defineArgument } from '../../lib/define-argument.js';
15	
16	export const blendArg = defineArgument({
17	  schema: z.string().regex(/^[a-z0-9-]+$/, 'Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes'),
18	  description: 'Blend of coffee',
19	  placeholder: 'blend',
20	});
21	```
22	
23	`--shots`, `--milk` and `--topping` are only used by this subcommand, so they are defined inline. `--format` comes from `global.options.js`:
24	
25	```js
26	// src/commands/coffee/coffee.brew.command.js
27	import { z } from 'zod';
28	import { brewCoffee } from '../../clever-client/coffee.js';
29	import { defineCommand } from '../../lib/define-command.js';
30	import { defineOption } from '../../lib/define-option.js';
31	import { Logger } from '../../logger.js';
32	import { sendToApi } from '../../models/send-to-api.js';
33	import { humanJsonOutputFormatOption } from '../global.options.js';
34	import { blendArg } from './coffee.args.js';
35	
36	export const coffeeBrewCommand = defineCommand({
37	  description: 'Brew a coffee',
38	  since: null,
39	  options: {
40	    shots: defineOption({
41	      name: 'shots',
42	      schema: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(4).default(1),
43	      description: 'Number of espresso shots',
44	      aliases: ['s'],
45	      placeholder: 'shots',
46	    }),
47	    milk: defineOption({
48	      name: 'milk',
49	      schema: z.enum(['none', 'whole', 'oat']).default('none'),
50	      description: 'Kind of milk',
51	      placeholder: 'milk',
52	    }),
53	    toppings: defineOption({
54	      name: 'topping',
55	      schema: z
56	        .union([z.string(), z.array(z.string())])
57	        .transform((value) => (typeof value === 'string' ? [value] : value))
58	        .optional(),
59	      description: 'Topping to add. Multiple --topping can be passed',
60	      placeholder: 'topping',
61	    }),

63	  },
64	  args: [blendArg],
65	  async handler(options, blend) {

content:
Manage the node groups of a Kubernetes cluster

USAGE
  clever k8s nodegroups

COMMANDS
  create    Create a node group on a Kubernetes cluster
  delete    Delete a node group of a Kubernetes cluster
  get       Get information about a node group of a Kubernetes cluster
  list      List the node groups of a Kubernetes cluster
  update    Update a node group of a Kubernetes cluster
Create a node group on a Kubernetes cluster

USAGE
  clever k8s nodegroups create --flavor <flavor> <cluster-id|cluster-name> <nodegroup-name> [options]

ARGUMENTS
  cluster-id|cluster-name                 Kubernetes cluster ID or name
  nodegroup-name                          Node group name

OPTIONS
      --flavor <flavor>                   Node flavor (e.g.: XS) (required)
      --autoscaling                       Enable autoscaling for this node group (requires --min and --max)
      --count <count>                     Target node count (default: 1)
      --description <description>         Free-form node group description
      --max <max>                         Maximum node count (autoscaling)
      --min <min>                         Minimum node count (autoscaling)
  -o, --org, --owner <org-id|org-name>    Organisation to target by its ID (or name, if unambiguous)
      --tag <tag>                         Tag of the node group

I added `clever k8s nodegroups` with `create`, `list`, `get`, `update` and `delete`. I checked it by running `--help` for the group and for `create`. I did not call the API, so none of the five subcommands has run against a real cluster.

`npm run fix-all` and `npm run validate` pass (lint, format, types, docs check). I had to run `npm ci` first because dependencies weren't installed.

**What exists**
- The API client functions and the `k8sCreateNodeGroup`, `k8sListNodeGroups`, `k8sGetNodeGroup`, `k8sUpdateNodeGroup` and `k8sDeleteNodeGroup` helpers were already in `src/clever-client/k8s.js` and `src/lib/k8s.js`. I only added the command layer.
- The new files are `src/commands/k8s/k8s.nodegroups*.command.js`, a `k8sNodeGroupIdOrNameArg` in `k8s.args.js`, and the registration in `global.commands.js`.
- `fix-all` regenerated `k8s.docs.md` and `skills/clever-tools/references/full-documentation.md`.
- The commands use `since: null`, as the project instructions require for new commands.

**Usage**
- `create <cluster> <name> --flavor <f>` also takes `--count` (default 1), `--description`, `--tag`, `--autoscaling`, `--min` and `--max`.
- `list <cluster>` and `get <cluster> <nodegroup>` accept `--format json`.
- `update <cluster> <nodegroup>` takes `--count`, `--description`, `--tag`, `--min`, `--max`, `--autoscaling` or `--disable-autoscaling`. It errors if you pass none of them.
- `delete <cluster> <nodegroup>` asks for confirmation unless you pass `--yes`.
- Node groups can be given by ID or by name, and every subcommand accepts `--org`.
- `nodegroups` is a plain group with no handler of its own, so running it alone just prints the subcommand list.

**For you to check**
- `fix-all` rewrote `.claude/settings.json` (Prettier reformatted it). I reverted that file, so it isn't part of the change.
- I didn't add anything to `SKILL.md`, because I didn't check whether it mentions the k8s commands.
- I made no commits.
